lessons.expl:
2StatementLINK · Jul 29, 2013 · 10:26
The Mishnah now lists 10 lost objects which can be kept by the finder and need not be returned.
① Scattered fruit
② Scattered money
③ Small bundles of wheat in a public place
④ Round pressed fig cakes
⑤ Loaves of a baker
⑥ Strings of fish
⑦ Cut pieces of meat
⑧ Shearings of wool as they are taken from the place from where they are cut
⑨ Bundles of flax
⑩ Tongues of purple dyed wool
The Mishnah says that these are the words of Rabbi Meir.

The Gemara answers: regarding the four questions of Rabbi Yirmiyah, we do not know the answer.
Now the word used in the Gemara to express this is teiku (תיקו).
This word is an acronym for the following:
תשבי – and that means Eliyahu ha-navi
יתרץ – and that means, he will answer
קושיות – and it means questions
ואבעיות – and it means and queries
